scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && for p in * .[^.]*; do [ "$p" = "dist" ] && continue; [ "$p" = ".git" ] && continue; [ "$p" = "node_modules" ] && continue; [ "$p" = "package.json" ] && continue; [ "$p" = "package-lock.json" ] && continue; case "$p" in *.py|*.sh|*.md) continue ;; esac; cp -R "$p" dist/; done
